map_role: Original foundry production islands; intentionally unfinished reverse-cascade industrial landscape
macro_topology: Five separate grounded process islets, an overhead northern bypass and isolated lower maintenance cavities, above a shared basalt substratum. Distinct sawtooth altitudes, no common horizontal hall roof.
density_profile: Dense machine silhouettes on each island; wide exposed vertical air slots, uncrowded high bypass, selectively unfinished enclosed cavities below
route_grammar: West lip Midge spawn -> ore roof/heat vessel -> descending ladle -> rising caster crown -> sloping quench -> freight east slip. Sky-level bypass and routes around the island shoulders rejoin; intentional edits can open lower service routes.
strong_motifs: ore chain hoist and suspended weight-cell
off-axis cantilever ladle and feed duct
interesting_relationships: Upstream ore island is higher than the ladle island, but caster returns to the upper level
A deliberately vacant cavity below the caster is separated from functional sky navigation
Thin trestles and boundary-rooted supports establish structural load paths
High sky bypass protects recovery when the central traversable opening is obstructed
